steps.title: Support Establishment
steps.details: Plant Gliricidia sepium supports 12 months before pepper planting.

steps.title: Pit Preparation
steps.details: Dig pits of 60cm x 60cm x 60cm and fill with topsoil and organic manure.

steps.title: Drainage Management
steps.details: Ensure proper drainage channels are cut to prevent waterlogging in clay soils.

steps.title: Soil Amendment
steps.details: Mix sand and organic matter into the pit to improve aeration.

steps.title: Soil Enrichment
steps.details: Apply Dolomite (500g/pit) to correct acidity common in Red-Yellow soils.

steps.title: Planting
steps.details: Plant cuttings with high orthotropic vigor.

steps.title: Moisture Conservation
steps.details: Sandy coastal soils dry fast; use coconut husk burial around the base.

steps.title: Irrigation
steps.details: Water frequently (every 2-3 days) during dry spells.

steps.title: Pit Filling
steps.details: Gravelly soil is poor; replace 50% of pit volume with good topsoil and cow dung.

steps.title: Water Retention
steps.details: Create a basin around the plant to catch rainwater.

steps.title: Irrigation Planning
steps.details: Critical: Apply 50L water per vine every 10 days.

steps.title: Soil Amendment
steps.details: Add large quantities of compost to improve water holding capacity.

steps.title: Hardpan Management
steps.details: Break up any hard subsoil layers before planting.

steps.title: Drought Protection
steps.details: Heavy mulching is mandatory.

steps.title: Shade Management
steps.details: Maintain 50% shade levels using Gliricidia.

steps.title: Mulching
steps.details: Apply thick mulch before the onset of dry season.
